blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.6
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.6

blocks.text: मोहावरणात्सिद्धिः
blocks.directed: [slowly] मोहावरणात्सिद्धिः

blocks.text: Mohāvaraṇāt siddhiḥ.
blocks.directed: Mohāvaraṇāt siddhiḥ.

blocks.text: Supernatural accomplishment arises because of the covering of delusion.
blocks.directed: Supernatural accomplishment arises because of the covering of delusion.

blocks.text: Congratulations, You’ve Acquired Superpowers. Unfortunately, You’re Still Deluded.
blocks.directed: Congratulations, You’ve Acquired Superpowers. Unfortunately, You’re Still Deluded.

blocks.text: Oh, this is BRUTAL.
blocks.directed: Oh, this is BRUTAL.

blocks.text: Absolutely ruthless.
blocks.directed: Absolutely ruthless.

blocks.text: Imagine you’ve spent twenty years practising yoga.
blocks.directed: Imagine you’ve spent twenty years practising yoga.

blocks.text: You’ve mastered concentration.
blocks.directed: You’ve mastered concentration.

blocks.text: You’ve performed elaborate contemplations of the elements.
blocks.directed: You’ve performed elaborate contemplations of the elements.

blocks.text: You’ve become adept at extraordinary states of absorption.
blocks.directed: You’ve become adept at extraordinary states of absorption.

blocks.text: And perhaps, within the traditional framework, you’ve acquired unusual siddhis.
blocks.directed: And perhaps, within the traditional framework, you’ve acquired unusual siddhis.

blocks.text: You arrive before Kṣemarāja.
blocks.directed: You arrive before Kṣemarāja.

blocks.text: “Master, I have attained extraordinary abilities.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Master, I have attained extraordinary abilities.”

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja replies:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And Kṣemarāja replies:

blocks.text: “Very impressive. That’s Māyā.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Very impressive. That’s Māyā.”

blocks.text: “Sorry?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Sorry?”

blocks.text: “Delusion, mate.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Delusion, mate.”

blocks.text: “But I can do remarkable things!”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “But I can do remarkable things!”

blocks.text: “Yes, within the realm of delusion.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Yes, within the realm of delusion.”

blocks.text: “I CAN LITERALLY—”
blocks.directed: “I CAN LITERALLY—”

blocks.text: “Still Māyā.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Still Māyā.”

blocks.text: Absolutely devastating.
blocks.directed: Absolutely devastating.

blocks.text: But philosophically, he’s making a precise distinction.
blocks.directed: But philosophically, he’s making a precise distinction.

blocks.text: Siddhi — accomplishment, perfection, supernatural power.
blocks.directed: Siddhi — accomplishment, perfection, supernatural power.

blocks.text: Moha — delusion, bewilderment.
blocks.directed: Moha — delusion, bewilderment.

blocks.text: Āvaraṇa — covering, concealment.
blocks.directed: Āvaraṇa — covering, concealment.

blocks.text: And the sūtra says that certain extraordinary powers arise within the covering of delusion.
blocks.directed: And the sūtra says that certain extraordinary powers arise within the covering of delusion.

blocks.text: Why?
blocks.directed: Why?

blocks.text: Because the powers described here concern differentiated realities.
blocks.directed: Because the powers described here concern differentiated realities.

blocks.text: They belong to the manifested domain of experience.
blocks.directed: They belong to the manifested domain of experience.

blocks.text: And the acquisition of unusual abilities within that domain doesn’t necessarily disclose the supreme reality beyond limited subject-object relations.
blocks.directed: And the acquisition of unusual abilities within that domain doesn’t necessarily disclose the supreme reality beyond limited subject-object relations.

blocks.text: Imagine somebody becomes extraordinarily skilled at lucid dreaming.
blocks.directed: Imagine somebody becomes extraordinarily skilled at lucid dreaming.

blocks.text: They can manipulate their dream environment.
blocks.directed: They can manipulate their dream environment.

blocks.text: Change the scenery.
blocks.directed: Change the scenery.

blocks.text: Fly through the sky.
blocks.directed: Fly through the sky.

blocks.text: Conjure objects.
blocks.directed: Conjure objects.

blocks.text: Perform impossible feats.
blocks.directed: Perform impossible feats.

blocks.text: Wonderful.
blocks.directed: Wonderful.

blocks.text: But does mastery over the dream automatically mean they’ve awakened from it?
blocks.directed: But does mastery over the dream automatically mean they’ve awakened from it?

blocks.text: Not necessarily.
blocks.directed: Not necessarily.

blocks.text: They may simply have become a very powerful character within the dream.
blocks.directed: They may simply have become a very powerful character within the dream.

blocks.text: This is analogous to Kṣemarāja’s argument.
blocks.directed: This is analogous to Kṣemarāja’s argument.

blocks.text: The siddhis are not necessarily the same as liberation.
blocks.directed: The siddhis are not necessarily the same as liberation.

blocks.text: And the deeper problem is that the practitioner may mistake control over phenomena for freedom from fundamental ignorance.
blocks.directed: And the deeper problem is that the practitioner may mistake control over phenomena for freedom from fundamental ignorance.

blocks.text: “I can control this.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I can control this.”

blocks.text: “I can manifest that.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I can manifest that.”

blocks.text: “I have acquired this power.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I have acquired this power.”

blocks.text: Notice that the entire grammar of limited selfhood remains intact.
blocks.directed: Notice that the entire grammar of limited selfhood remains intact.

blocks.text: A finite subject acquires powers over finite or extraordinary objects.
blocks.directed: A finite subject acquires powers over finite or extraordinary objects.

blocks.text: The structure of identification has not necessarily changed.
blocks.directed: The structure of identification has not necessarily changed.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explicitly differentiates powers obtained through yogic techniques from direct manifestation of the supreme principle.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explicitly differentiates powers obtained through yogic techniques from direct manifestation of the supreme principle.

blocks.text: But he also makes an important qualification.
blocks.directed: But he also makes an important qualification.

blocks.text: The same disciplines can contribute to genuine recognition when directed towards their highest aim.
blocks.directed: The same disciplines can contribute to genuine recognition when directed towards their highest aim.

blocks.text: He cites teachings from the Netratantra describing withdrawal from subtle objects, meditation on supreme consciousness, and the contemplative understanding of one’s identity with Śiva. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: He cites teachings from the Netratantra describing withdrawal from subtle objects, meditation on supreme consciousness, and the contemplative understanding of one’s identity with Śiva. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: So he’s not rejecting practice.
blocks.directed: So he’s not rejecting practice.

blocks.text: He’s rejecting a confusion about its purpose.
blocks.directed: He’s rejecting a confusion about its purpose.

blocks.text: The aim of Āṇavopāya isn’t to become the most impressive individual in the universe.
blocks.directed: The aim of Āṇavopāya isn’t to become the most impressive individual in the universe.

blocks.text: It’s to recognise the conscious reality in which individuality itself appears.
blocks.directed: It’s to recognise the conscious reality in which individuality itself appears.

blocks.text: And this is the wonderful paradox.
blocks.directed: And this is the wonderful paradox.

blocks.text: You could acquire the power to perform astonishing feats.
blocks.directed: You could acquire the power to perform astonishing feats.

blocks.text: And still be bound.
blocks.directed: And still be bound.

blocks.text: Or you could have no unusual abilities whatsoever and recognise the nature of awareness.
blocks.directed: Or you could have no unusual abilities whatsoever and recognise the nature of awareness.

blocks.text: Within this system, the latter is the more fundamental spiritual accomplishment.
blocks.directed: Within this system, the latter is the more fundamental spiritual accomplishment.

blocks.text: Which is a terrible blow to the supernatural entertainment industry.
blocks.directed: Which is a terrible blow to the supernatural entertainment industry.

blocks.text: But excellent news for anyone whose principal skill is sitting quietly and investigating consciousness.
blocks.directed: But excellent news for anyone whose principal skill is sitting quietly and investigating consciousness.
